item.title: AFCON: It worked – Egypt coach, Hassan reveals why his team defeated Ivory Coast

item.title: Saudi airlines diversion leaves Kano-bound passengers stranded at Abuja airport for hours
item.description: Hundreds of Nigerian pilgrims returning from Saudi Arabia were left stranded inside a Saudi Arabian airlines plane for about five hours at the Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport in Abuja after the flight was diverted from Kano due to bad weather. item.title: Hajj tax: Nigerian govt to earn about N5.4bn from 2026 pilgrims
item.description: The federal government is expected to make about N5.4bn from Nigerian pilgrims taking part in the 2026 Hajj through a compulsory service charge, a new report has said. The figure was released by the Independent Hajj Reporters (IHR), a civil society group that monitors transparency in Hajj operations.
